description: This file defines a custom exception class 'InvalidAccountInformationException' used within the Fineract project to signal invalid account details. It extends a base exception class and constructs an error message based on specific account information parameters.

classes.name: InvalidAccountInformationException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to indicate invalid account information, extending the platform's domain rule exception base class.

methods.name: InvalidAccountInformationException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a detailed message composed of account details (officeName, accountNumber, accountType).
